tier_compliance.reason: It connects the visible topmost layer with the concept of surface soil without identifying bedrock, as Tier 2 requests.

visual_grounding.reason: "The topmost layer" identifies a specific visible region of this soil profile.

scientific_correctness.reason: "Organic matter like soil or topsoil" incorrectly treats soil itself as organic matter; soil contains mineral particles as well as organic matter.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: Although it focuses on the surface, it does not tell the student to identify that layer as bedrock or otherwise favour a wrong answer.

answer_disclosure.reason: Identifying the top soil layer as surface soil helps rule out its label D as bedrock without identifying the correct label.

actionability.reason: It directs attention to the topmost layer, but the student must work out how to use that information to locate bedrock.
